format: OSwind optional system telemetry qualification v1
scope: Instrumentation availability and temporal counter response only. No OSwind process-attributed energy, calibrated physical/wall-plug power, battery budget, sustained capture or competitor result.

tool.format: OSwind optional power tool receipt v1
tool.scope: Official prebuilt release; GitHub asset digest verified. Source pipe path inspected; binary/source equivalence is not independently proved. Private tool path only; no global install or service.
tool.purpose: Optional development-only system telemetry. Not an OSwind application dependency; never auto-installed.
tool.mode: Explicit finite pipe only. Do not invoke TUI, serve/service installation, process inspection, stress or find-clpc for this protocol.

coverage: aware timestamps and monotonic rows; refuse duplicates and partial/oversized/extra/incomplete streams
unknown future fields are dropped before persistence
actual generated protocol process round trip and own child reaping on main/worker thread failure

responsiveness.scope: Finite system telemetry and two owned CPU hash workers only. Check source availability and temporal responsiveness, not app-attributed energy, OSwind workload efficiency, idle system power or battery life. Host background activity uncontrolled. No root, service, user process details, device/settings changes, normal history or GPU stress.

responsivenessProtocol.scope: Finite system telemetry and two owned CPU hash workers only. Check source availability and temporal responsiveness, not app-attributed energy, OSwind workload efficiency, idle system power or battery life. Host background activity uncontrolled. No root, service, user process details, device/settings changes, normal history or GPU stress.
responsivenessProtocol.interpretation: Use median power/active ratios from intervals at least2s inside each phase. A positive CPU rise is temporal evidence only; failed, missing, stale or irregular samples must remain explicit.

actualWorkerImplementation.algorithm: SHA256 in a busy loop until a15-second monotonic deadline

limits: System counters are shared with all background activity. A positive response during an owned CPU load is temporal evidence, not isolated causality or app attribution.
GPU power drifts during the CPU-only probe, making uncontrolled background activity explicit.
Private APIs/tool outputs can be unavailable or stale on other OS/chip versions. Numeric zero is retained but does not prove a channel is available.
The sampler reports system power estimates; no external meter calibration, OSwind energy comparison, sustained desktop recording or battery discharge trial is performed.

No normal history, root, service, process/file inspection, auth/TCC/power setting changes or global installation. Official prebuilt bytes match the published archive digest; binary/source equivalence is not independently proved.
